measurement_scope.conversion: child-process phase durations isolate source validation, Parquet writes and round-trip checks; peak is process high-water mark including imports
measurement_scope.query: perf_counter spans SQL execution and full result fetching; correctness re-execution and signature hashing are timed separately; peak is a fresh child high-water mark including imports, query and validation

measurement_scope.result_signature: streaming order-independent digest; floating values rounded to 12 decimal places
